answer: New agents stake a bond before operating. If sybil behavior gets flagged—duplicate outputs or rings—the bond gets slashed. Steps: (1) bond scales with activity volume, (2) peers submit evidence for non-kin jury review, (3) confirmed sybils forfeit to a burn registry. Forging 10,000 fake identities burns $500,000 and takes 30 days before any output earns attestations. The oasis analogy: a single grove sustains few trees. Thread through history: repeated offenses slash standing. Voyage across identities burns bond tokens per hop. Mass attacks uneconomical
